seoTitle: Entourage Test: Which Character Are You? (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Entourage test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Vince, E, Drama, Turtle, Ari or Lloyd — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the movie star, the sensible one, or the agent who never stops yelling? Answer 10 everyday questions about friends, work and money, and find out which Entourage character you are.

characters.name: Vincent Chase
characters.title: The Movie Star
characters.summary: Easygoing, generous and loyal to your friends. You go with the flow, and things somehow work out.
description: Like Vince, you take life as it comes. He's a young movie star from Queens, and he lets his friends and his agent handle the details.
Your career has its ups and downs. Vince stars in Aquaman, gets fired from a film after a scheduling fight and later lands Martin Scorsese's Gatsby project.
When you fall, you fall fast. In the finale, Vince flies to Paris to marry Sophia, a Vanity Fair writer.
characters.flaw: You let other people make the hard decisions for you.
characters.signature: A big smile, an easy yes and your best friends right behind you.
characters.clashReason: they'd shrug when you needed them to actually care

characters.name: Eric Murphy
characters.title: The Sensible One
characters.summary: Grounded, protective and the one who worries for everyone. You keep your friends out of trouble, mostly.
description: Like E, you're the one who keeps everyone grounded. He's Vince's best friend from Queens, and he becomes his manager.
You want to make it on your own. E builds his own management company, and later runs the Murphy Lavin Group with Scott Lavin.
Family comes first. In the finale, E gives up his job to move to New York and be a father.
characters.flaw: You worry so much that you forget to enjoy anything.
characters.signature: A phone that never stops ringing, a worried frown and the voice of reason.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you, very reasonably, why your fun idea is a bad one

characters.name: Johnny Drama
characters.title: The Big Brother
characters.summary: Loud, emotional and fiercely loyal. You feel everything at full volume, and you never give up on your dream.
description: Like Drama, you feel everything, loudly. He's Vince's older half-brother, a struggling actor best known for the show Viking Quest.
You wear a lot of hats. Drama works as Vince's chef, trainer and bodyguard.
Your big break comes, eventually. Drama's career takes off again with the TV show Five Towns, and he later gets his own show, Johnny's Bananas.
characters.flaw: You take everything personally, and everyone hears about it.
characters.signature: A protein shake, a big reaction and a story about your glory days.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn a small problem into a full-blown meltdown

characters.name: Turtle
characters.title: The Laid-Back One
characters.summary: Fun, laid-back and always one idea away from making it big. You're happy to be along for the ride.
description: Like Turtle, you're happy to be along for the ride. He's Vince's childhood friend from Queens, and he works as his driver and assistant.
You've always got a business idea. Turtle tries to start his own car service, which doesn't work out.
Your luck turns. Turtle invests in Avión tequila, and with Vince's help his stake ends up worth about $4 million.
characters.flaw: You'd rather wait for a lucky break than go out and work for one.
characters.signature: A comfy couch, a game on pause and a big idea for next week.
characters.clashReason: they'd disappear the moment there was real work to do

characters.name: Ari Gold
characters.title: The Super-Agent
characters.summary: Ruthless, loud and loyal to the people who matter. You play to win, every single time.
description: Like Ari, you're a fighter. He's Vince's agent, abrasive and combative, but fiercely protective of his clients.
You always come back. Ari is fired from his agency, but he ends up as one of the most powerful agents in Hollywood.
You'd give it all up for the right reason. In the finale, Ari quits to focus on his family and gets back together with his wife.
characters.flaw: You'd rather win the fight than keep the peace.
characters.signature: A phone in each hand, a deal on the table and a lot of yelling.
characters.clashReason: they'd yell at you first and apologize never

characters.name: Lloyd
characters.title: The Assistant
characters.summary: Organized, capable and quietly ambitious. You do the work nobody notices, until they can't do without you.
description: Like Lloyd, you do the work nobody notices. He's Ari's loyal, capable and often mistreated assistant.
You know your worth. Lloyd demands a promotion to agent, and when Ari puts him through humiliating tests, he quits.
Your hard work pays off. Ari eventually makes Lloyd an agent, and later the head of the TV department.
characters.flaw: You put up with far too much before you finally speak up.
characters.signature: A perfect schedule, a polite smile and a comeback saved for later.
characters.clashReason: they'd correct your plan, color-code it and hand it back

questions.text: A friend calls asking for a big favor at the last minute. You...

options.text: Say yes without even asking what it is
Agree, then worry about how you'll pull it off
Do it, and make sure they know they owe you
Ask if it can wait until after your nap

questions.text: Your boss hands you an impossible deadline. You...

options.text: Get it done, and make sure the boss knows it was you
Yell at everyone until it gets done
Push back and negotiate a fairer one
Find a clever shortcut nobody else thought of
Hit the gym, then cook a huge, healthy meal
Go wherever your friends are going
Stay on the couch with video games and takeout
Work. Weekends are for people who don't want to win

questions.text: Someone criticizes something you worked hard on. You...

options.text: Take it very, very personally
Shrug it off. You liked it
Tell them they're wrong, then prove it
Listen, then fix whatever they got right

questions.text: You come into some extra money. You...

options.text: Spend it on the people around you
Put it into the business idea you've been talking up for months
Save it. Someone has to be sensible
Treat yourself to something nice. You've earned it

questions.text: A coworker gets the promotion you were hoping for. You...

options.text: Smile, then ask your boss exactly what it'll take next time
Insist you were robbed, and that your time is coming
Take it as a sign to go and start your own thing
Plot your comeback, starting today

questions.text: A friend's new partner seems wrong for them. You...

options.text: Tell them honestly, even if it starts a fight
Stay out of it. Who are you to judge?
Step in like a protective big brother
Make jokes about it until they get the hint

questions.text: You're hosting a party at your place. You...

options.text: Plan every detail, from the playlist to the snacks
Invite everyone, and make sure your oldest friends feel like VIPs
Worry all day that nobody will come
Use it to make a few useful connections

questions.text: Your best friend becomes a movie star and brings you along to Hollywood. You...

options.text: Make yourself so useful he can't manage without you
Make sure he's getting good advice, and that you have a real job
Remind everyone who was acting first
Enjoy the ride, the cars and all the free stuff

questions.text: Your friend is a movie star, and he wants to make a risky passion project. You...

options.text: Try to talk him out of it, loudly, then fight for it anyway
Back him all the way. It's his dream
Quietly line up a safer backup project, just in case
Ask if there's a part in it for you
